subjects.name: SpfWbsStep
subjects.domain: pedal 0..4; previous mode 0..1, command 0..4, pressure 0..5; all flags; other inputs return -1
subjects.adaptation: Expose previous state as inputs; retain complete update control flow; encode outputs normal + 10*alternate + 100*mode. Does not model multi-step reachability.

subjects.name: SpfFlapMotion
subjects.domain: goal and initial position 0..40; emergency flag
subjects.adaptation: Execute sensor before motion; preserve movement and time>1 assertion as -2; -1 rejects domain. No interleavings or concurrency claim.

subjects.name: SpfBankWithdrawal
subjects.adaptation: Expose object state; keep input values immutable and copy balance to local currentBalance; inline deposit then withdraw; return final balance or -2 assertion. Preserve negative withdrawal behavior rather than silently fixing it.

subjects.name: SpfDelimiterSearch
subjects.domain: three character text and two delimiters, each code 0..9
subjects.adaptation: Flatten fixed-length strings into scalar character codes, preserve nested search loops and earliest match; replace continue with equivalent fall-through.

subjects.name: SpfSubstringCount
subjects.domain: four-character haystack and two-character needle; codes 0..9
subjects.adaptation: Flatten strings; retain nested search and overlapping occurrences.

subjects.name: SpfSortedInsertion
subjects.domain: sorted three-node list with values 0..9; inserted digit 0..9
subjects.adaptation: Replace next pointers by cursor and scalar fields; preserve search for insertion location; encode all four output digits, including leading zeros. Fixed length makes encoding injective.

subjects.name: SpfTreeSearch
subjects.adaptation: Fix tree shape to root with two leaves; replace references/null by node indices/-1; preserve traversal.

subjects.name: SpfAbortDecision
subjects.domain: offset -1000..1000 and flags; original altitude = 120000 + altitudeOffset
subjects.adaptation: Translate altitude around its threshold (no overflow on domain); flatten EnumSet to failure flag, state strings to tags; inline setNextState; preserve ambiguous transition assertion at offset=0 as -2. Original defect is retained and specified, not repaired.

subjects.name: SpfRjcCounter
subjects.adaptation: Flatten one-element state/output arrays; inline state dispatch and transitions; bound repeated controller ticks.

subjects.name: SpfStackPops
subjects.domain: push three digits then pop 0..4 times
subjects.adaptation: Flatten three nodes to slots and depth; inline pop/isEmpty; return last popped value, -3 for no pop and -2 for empty-stack exception; remove diagnostic printing. Annotation preconditions are not enforced by ordinary Java; zero values deliberately retained.

validation_scope: Exhaustive mapped finite domains; expanded CSC completion; nontrivial FSF verification with every scenario matched. Not RQ1/RQ2/RQ3 experiments or full upstream verification.
